summary: L-4 lookout replica built in 2005 for a Smithsonian festival in Washington, D.C.; now at ground level on the National Museum of Forest Service History campus near Missoula.

facts.design: L-4 style lookout replica, based on 1930s-era plans
facts.agency: National Museum of Forest Service History, a nonprofit independent of the USDA Forest Service
facts.status_note: A 2005 replica, not the original 1930s-era lookout, and not on its first site.

access.note: Museum campus open seasonally, 10am to 4pm, Memorial Day weekend to the day after Labor Day, seven days a week, per a listing written while the new building was under construction; current hours may differ.

visit.trail_note: Set at ground level in the middle of the Forest Discovery Trail, per a 2020 association report.

events.note: Built by the Forest Service's preservation team for the Smithsonian Folklife Festival on the Mall in Washington, D.C., celebrating the Forest Service centennial, with materials salvaged from Minton Peak Lookout.
A $500 Forest Fire Lookout Association restoration grant, matched by its Montana-North Idaho Chapter, was used for restoration of the lookout on the museum grounds.

notes_for_editor: Identity and history are well sourced: the 2005 Smithsonian Folklife Festival build, the move to the campus and the 2020 restoration grant. Two disagreements: campus size is 31 acres in the Destination Missoula listing and 36 acres in the 2020 FFLA report (the story states both). Current location and condition come from a 2020 report and an undated listing, so a site check would confirm the Forest Discovery Trail placement. The museum's listed hours predate the July 17, 2026 opening of the National Conservation Legacy Center, so current hours may differ. Do not conflate with the separate FFLA record 'Missoula Aerial Fire Depot (Hornet Peak Replica)' at 46.92544, -114.09044, another ground replica nearby. The record's status 'replica' and kind 'ground' are supported; no correction proposed. No staffing or fire history given in any source. No photos added.
